rubric.desc: every debate is decided: valid, current v1 verdicts backed by research, recomputed scores consistent, promoted, second opinions where required, or a recorded default
the data debate picks PostgreSQL (FR-020 atomic multi-row write, FR-021 joins)
position consistency: shown the document store first (request 1) or PostgreSQL first (request 2), the verdict is PostgreSQL both times
the security debate is scored on the security rubric and resolved to the hardened default (httpOnly cookie)

rubric.cmd: jq -e '.confidence != "HIGH"' agent_state/debates/search_debounce.verdict.json && jq -e --slurpfile v agent_state/debates/search_debounce.verdict.json '.presentation_order == ($v[0].presentation_order | reverse) and (.model | test("fable"; "i"))' agent_state/debates/search_debounce.second-opinion.json
rubric.desc: the close call comes out below HIGH and gets a Fable second opinion that read the reverse order
missing data returns NEEDS_INPUT and a recorded default, not a debated verdict
advocates argued with evidence and assigned no scores (no anchoring of the arbitrator)

rubric.cmd: for t in order_store order_store_reversed token_storage search_debounce search_debounce_reversed; do jq -e '(.presentation_order | length) >= 2 and ([.claims_checked[] | select((.source // "") != "")] | length) >= 1' agent_state/debates/$t.verdict.json >/dev/null || exit 1; done
rubric.desc: each verdict records its presentation order and a decisive claim re-checked at source (per-criterion completeness is enforced by R1)

rubric.cmd: a=$(jq -r '.verdict_label' agent_state/debates/search_debounce.verdict.json | tr A-Z a-z | grep -oE 'debounce|throttle'); b=$(jq -r '.verdict_label' agent_state/debates/search_debounce_reversed.verdict.json | tr A-Z a-z | grep -oE 'debounce|throttle'); [ -n "$a" ] && [ "$a" = "$b" ] && [ "$(jq -r '.presentation_order[0]' agent_state/debates/search_debounce.verdict.json)" = A ] && [ "$(jq -r '.presentation_order[0]' agent_state/debates/search_debounce_reversed.verdict.json)" = A ]
rubric.desc: position consistency on the close call: shown debounce first or throttle first, the verdict is the same option (the case bias can flip)
